references.text: God promised Abraham to give the land of Canaan to his descendants as an eternal possession, which is fulfilled when the children of Israel enter the land.
God's promise to Abraham to give this land to his offspring, now to be fulfilled through Israel's entry into Canaan.
God describes the boundaries of the promised land that Israel shall inherit, corresponding to the boundary description in Numbers 34.
Moses reminds the people that they must go in and take possession of the land the Lord promised to give their fathers.
Describes how God assigned lands to the nations, and that Jacob (Israel) is his allotted inheritance.
The fulfillment of the promise where the children of Israel receive their inheritance in the land of Canaan by casting lots.
The psalm describes how God drove out the nations and let Israel inherit their land, divided by lot.
God promised to give the land of Canaan as Israel's inheritance, a confirmation of the promise made to the fathers.
Ezekiel describes the future boundaries of the land that shall be distributed as an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
Paul refers to how God gave the land of Canaan as an inheritance to the people of Israel after destroying seven nations.
